title: Frames of a sprite sheet
description:
Work out the source rectangle of each frame in a sprite sheet.

```
sheet 256x64, frames 32x32 -> 8 columns, 2 rows, 16 frames
frame 0  -> (0, 0, 32, 32)
frame 9  -> (32, 32, 32, 32)
frame 16 -> out of range
flipped frame 3 -> (96, 0, -32, 32)
```
hints: `columns = sheetW / frameW`; frame `i` is at column `i % columns` and row `i / columns` (lesson 2.02).
Check `index < columns * rows` before working anything out.
requirements: Frames go left to right, then down.
A flipped frame has a negative width, as `DrawTextureRec` expects for mirroring.
stretch: Add spacing and a margin between frames, as many sheets have.
